title: Experience Engine v0: deterministic sensor-action-reward loop
objective: Test whether the controlled Experience Engine completes a reproducible target task and routes only environment feedback as reward.
controls: unauthorized action must produce no observation and no reward
same deterministic sensor trace must produce identical frames
runtime hook must execute one existing network tick only
analysis: Report per-condition success rate, reward count, audit validity, and any runtime errors. Do not infer biological life, consciousness, or general intelligence.
evidence_policy: No EVID artifact before clean source freeze, independent runs, complete provenance, and validated analysis.
